title: With the VIN toggle on, day-view lane heights grow so block text is not clipped
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. A shift exists for a unit with a VIN.
3. You are on the Schedule page in day view with the VIN toggle OFF.
steps: 1. Note the height of the shift's lane and that its text fits.
2. Turn the VIN toggle ON in 'Filter and Display'.
expected: 1. With VIN on, the lane height grows to accommodate the additional VIN line.
2. No block text is clipped or cut off.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
notes: VIN-on grows the day-view lane height (DAY_LANE_H schedVin 96 vs 80) pinned by the Claude design (§3); the toggle label is 'VIN Number' (design §6). Driver: Claude design §3/§6.
